note: Runtime UI rows whose translation is wrong in sense. The guides use a correct term; these rows need a runtime-catalog fix.

defects.Anndata nan policy: 'Política de la empresa Anndata nan' means 'company policy'; the setting is the missing-value (NaN) policy ('Política de NaN de AnnData')
defects.Anndata out: 'Annadata out' is a misspelled English leftover; the setting is the AnnData output file ('Salida de AnnData')
defects.Inputs: 'Aportaciones' means 'contributions'; the workflow card lists inputs ('Entradas')
defects.Outputs: 'Productos' means 'products'; the workflow card lists outputs ('Salidas')
defects.Model zoo…: 'Zoológico modelo...' means 'model zoo (animal park)'; the screen is 'Biblioteca de modelos'
defects.Promote calls to annotation: 'Promover llamadas a la anotación' reads 'promote (phone) calls to the annotation'; the action turns calls into annotations
defects.Undo promotion: 'Deshacer la promoción' reads as undoing a sales/job promotion
defects.Taper onto the gradient: 'Cinta en el gradiente' means 'tape on the gradient'
defects.Train: 'Tren' is a railway train; the Workbench tab means 'Entrenar'
defects.Walk: 'Caminar' means walking on foot; the switch selects the local step-by-step search ('Búsqueda paso a paso')
defects.Resume checkpoint: 'Reanudar el puesto de control' uses a police/border checkpoint; the setting resumes from a saved checkpoint ('Reanudar desde el punto de control')
defects.Hit List: 'Lista de aciertos' means a list of correct answers; screen hits are candidates ('Lista de candidatos')
defects.Setting animations: 'Configuración de animaciones' reads 'animation configuration'; the preference means animations for settings ('Animaciones de ajustes')
